items.description: Black domed capitol with phoenix pediment, gold '8' banners, landing pads, and starships. Printed banner text: 'PHOENIX GOD / ANTERRANIAN MONORCH' (sic — art spells MONORCH; official title Anterranian Monarch).

printed_text.note: Art prints MONORCH (missing A); canonical spelling is MONARCH.

items.notes: Landmark catalog entry. Gold '8' banners/plaques reinforce pending question on meaning of the '8'. Title Phoenix God recorded. Batch_23 adds floating-pads and gold-dome dragon-crest variants.

variants.description: Capitol variant with floating circular landing pads, phoenix pediment, stacked gold plaques reading '8 / PHOENIX GOD / ANTERRANIAN MONAACH' (sic MONARCH; art doubles the A), magenta nebula backdrop, starships.

printed_text.note: Art prints MONAACH (extra A); canonical spelling is MONARCH.
